title: Self-attention reduces effective resolution due to averaging
description: Unlike convolutional or recurrent layers that maintain position-specific representations, self-attention computes a weighted average of all positions, which can blur fine-grained positional information. Multi-head attention counteracts this but does not eliminate the fundamental trade-off.
canonical_description: self-attention averages attention-weighted positions reducing effective resolution

evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
